plugins.description: Every game-dev loop in Claude Code: one-page design, build in small playtested slices, bot and agent playtests on your real build, balance sweeps and sims, iterate from evidence, human playtest logs and player feedback, and itch/Steam/web shipping that blocks undisclosed AI art.
